articles.title: Anodized
articles.summary: Deep navy-blue matte metal, faint gritty grain, no gloss, flat and dark overall. Reads as an even, dark dusty blue-violet metal with a quiet matte-satin look; no sparkle, no pattern.
articles.what: Apple-product oxide layer — color dyed into metal, not painted on. Gritty matte, no clearcoat feel. Tech/modern builds. Up close: The paint is a smooth, slightly mottled dusky blue-violet with almost no visible grain. The detail is in the spec panels: faint cloudy streaks in metal and clearcoat, a bright roughness field, and sparse single-pixel white and black pinholes like pores in an oxide layer. From a distance: Reads as an even, dark dusty blue-violet metal with a quiet matte-satin look; no sparkle, no pattern. Measured spec (average): metal 116, roughness 99, coat 29. Shine: satin. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.
